application-shell.reason: Application bootstrap, runtime config, modules and routing are organization-level stability contracts.

error-model.reason: AppError, normalization and shared UI text semantics are cross-cutting stability contracts used by generated project code.

ui-patterns.reason: Page/state patterns should remain stable while implementation may reuse mature upstream components.

data-table.reason: Projects need a stable table contract; mature upstream implementations may reduce maintenance.

forms.reason: Form layout and AppError mapping are organizational contracts; widgets may be upstream-backed.

permission.reason: Permission UX contract stays stable; provider internals may reuse a headless upstream if it proves cheaper.

api-transport.reason: Problem Details, trace IDs, abort/timeout semantics and OpenAPI integration are organization-specific contracts.

file-transfer.reason: Validation and transfer-state semantics are reused by engineering/data applications.

async-operation.reason: Long-running tasks, cancellation, polling and logs are a recurring non-CRUD requirement.

visualization.reason: Engineering/data projects need consistent ECharts lifecycle and time-series semantics.

theme.reason: Semantic tokens and project branding must stay under Foundation governance.

observability.reason: Telemetry adapters must keep business code vendor-neutral.
